name: kanban
title: Kanban
description: KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn and KanbanCard: columns side by side (horizontal scroll on small screens) with counts and empty text; cards move by native HTML5 drag and drop or with a «Mover a…» select on each card (keyboard and touch). Only card drags are accepted; onMove(cardId, toColumnId) on the board. Copy via props.
